summary: Ramsey promises a return visit; commercial for Sony recorders.

blocks.x: Well, Monk, we want to get back to this. I want to have you back again in a week or so, so that we can play some of your older records, which I couldn't get a hold of right now. But let's take a short break here, and then we'll come back with some more modern music that I want you to kind of evaluate for us, if you would. We'll be right back after this message.

Portable Stereo tape recorders by Sony are easygoing for people on the go. The portable 230, for example, is smartly styled, rugged, compact, and ready to go where you go.
